subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the funded-account program for {Brand}. My first email laid out the MMP read on funded accounts, and the second put it against where Irish neobank CAC actually lands. If funded-account quality and incrementality are on your roadmap this year, I can share the cost-per-funded-account view and a short holdout read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it is useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN fintech_banking_and_payments: references original email + both earlier stages so the cascade reads as one thread; direct close with easy out (release if timing wrong); no figure; zero question marks; no sign-off; no em-dash; phrased positively, no X-not-Y; native English.
